name: Child Disability Allowance
description: Child Disability Allowance is a payment for caregivers of children with serious disabilities requiring constant care and attention.

attributes.summary: A financial allowance paid to the principal caregiver of a dependent child with a serious disability who requires constant care and attention, subject to residency, medical, and living arrangement criteria.
attributes.eligibility: Must be principal caregiver of a dependent child with a serious disability requiring constant care and attention; residency and immigration status requirements apply; not payable when child is in care of Oranga Tamariki
attributes.payment_details: Allowance payment type; qualifications include residency, immigration status, medical grounds, and living arrangements
attributes.obligations: Duty to advise of changes in circumstances; subject to annual review and event-based reviews; provisions for absence from New Zealand and hospitalisation
